name: 🍛 One-Pot Chicken & Chickpea Curry
what: Chicken and chickpeas simmered in a mild coconut curry, over rice.

core.name: Chicken breasts
core.out: chicken thighs, or just more chickpeas

core.name: Coconut milk
core.out: a cup of plain yogurt stirred in at the end, off the heat

core.name: Curry paste
core.out: 2 Tbsp mild curry powder, fried the same way

extras: onion, garlic, ginger, diced tomatoes, spinach, naan, yogurt to serve

moves.text: Pull the must-haves onto the counter. Start the rice.
Soften the onion in oil in a big pot. Add garlic, ginger and the curry paste; fry 1–2 minutes.
Add the chicken pieces and salt; stir to coat.
Pour in the coconut milk, chickpeas and some tomatoes. Simmer.
Stir in spinach. Serve over rice with naan and a spoon of yogurt.

key: Fry the curry paste in the oil before anything wet goes in. That's the takeout flavor.
done: Chicken is white all the way through and the sauce has thickened.
plan_b: No chicken? Chickpea and veggie curry, same steps.
